mounts.finderLockBlocked: Filen in Finder is off while an app lock PIN is set, so your files can't be opened without it.
mounts.finderNeedsEnabling: Switch on Filen in System Settings, under General > Login Items & Extensions, to see it in Finder.
mounts.finderNotRegistered: Filen couldn't add itself to Finder. Turn Filen in Finder off and on again.
mounts.finderOpenDescription: Browse your Filen drive in Finder.
mounts.finderRecommended: Filen in Finder is recommended on this Mac; the network drive stays available for apps that need a mounted drive.
mounts.finderTranslocated: Move Filen to Applications first, then open it from there to use Filen in Finder.
mounts.fuseInstallRebootRequired: WinFsp is installed. Restart your computer to mount the drive.
mounts.fuseMissing: The drive can't be mounted on this system. The servers still work.
mounts.fuseMissingDevice: This system has no FUSE device (/dev/fuse), as in a container or sandbox, so the drive can't be mounted here. The servers still work.
mounts.fuseMissingFuse3: Mounting the drive needs the fuse3 package. Install it with your package manager, then try again.
mounts.fuseMissingInstallable: Mounting the drive needs WinFsp, which isn't installed.
mounts.hostAddonMissing: The drive and servers can't run because part of Filen is missing. Reinstall Filen if this keeps happening.
mounts.hostBaselineInUse: Another copy of Filen is using this account's data. Quit it and try again.
mounts.hostCrashLoop: The Filen helper kept stopping unexpectedly, so Filen turned it off.
mounts.hostKeychainLocked: Filen couldn't read your session from the system keychain. Unlock it and try again.
mounts.hostRestarting: The Filen helper stopped unexpectedly and restarts shortly.
mounts.httpsOffBody: The server listens on {{address}}. Without HTTPS, credentials travel in plain text and anyone on the network can read them and your files.
mounts.noticeAddressInvalid: A server's address from the previous version of Filen can't be used any more, so the server is off. Choose an address to run it again.
mounts.noticeCertificateRegenerated: A server's HTTPS certificate was made anew. Clients that trusted the old one must trust the new one.
mounts.noticeCredentialsRegenerated: Some servers' credentials from the previous version of Filen couldn't be kept, so Filen made new ones. Clients using the old credentials must sign in with the new ones.
mounts.noticeLegacyCacheErrored: Some files from the previous version of Filen couldn't be uploaded. Filen keeps them and tries again on the next start.
mounts.noticeLegacyUploadsPending: Files from the previous version of Filen are still uploading. Keep Filen open until they are done.
mounts.noticeMountPointInvalid: The network drive's old mount point can't be used any more, so the drive is off. Choose a new one to mount it.
mounts.problemHomeDirectory: It can't be your home directory itself.
mounts.problemOutsideHome: It has to be inside your home directory.
mounts.problemSymlink: It's a link to another location.
mounts.problemTemporary: It's in a temporary location the system may empty.
mounts.serveAddressNfs: NFS has no sign-in, so it only listens on this device.
mounts.serveCredentialsDescription: Clients sign in with these. They are only for this server, never your Filen password.
mounts.serveHttpsDescription: Encrypts connections with a certificate made on this device.
mounts.servePlainText: This server listens on your network without HTTPS, so credentials and files travel in plain text.
mounts.serveReadOnlyDescription: Clients can open files but not change them.
mounts.serveUnauthenticated: {{protocol}} has no sign-in. Anyone on this device can use the server while it runs.
mounts.serveUrlOff: Shown once the server is on.
mounts.tuningDescription: These apply to the network drive and every server. Running ones restart to use them.
mounts.tuningMinFree: Space to keep free on the disk (GiB)
mounts.tuningRowDescription: Size, age and refresh of the cache the drive and every server share.
mounts.unauthenticatedBody: {{protocol}} has no sign-in. While it runs, any app or user on this device can read and change your Filen drive through it.
mounts.unavailable: The drive and servers can't run because part of Filen is missing or damaged. Reinstall Filen.
